task: Read-only actual Tracer development project orientation at native163

agentReport.text:
# Real-project orientation review

Read-only UI walkthrough of the faithful Tracer development-project copy at `http://127.0.0.1:64055`, snapshot r163. No records, evaluations, judgments, conclusions, observations or saved views were changed. No source files, application APIs, SQL or fixture internals were consulted. Exploration stopped at the parent's instruction; both opened browser sessions were closed.

## Landing finding revised

The actual project is substantially more recognizable than the tiny synthetic fixture. Landing selected **ART-COMP-UI — User interface source boundary**, with eight named artifacts and seven links, including Tracer, User interface, contextual authoring, Graph Matrix and History, model editing and requirements. This communicates an engineering project and connected scope. The fixture's opaque UUID landing was not representative evidence for requiring a dashboard.

**Next work** is an immediately visible entry point. It explains five separate queues, overlapping membership, and that these are recorded gaps/review work rather than release readiness. It showed snapshot r163/model v7, 52 requirements checked, zero missing statements, 69 changed-evidence inputs and 88 unresolved reviews; allocation and verification-plan queues were explicitly not configured. Search found the requested requirement and its failure, correction, verification and assessment records directly.

## REQ-011 evidence found

- Requirement **Explain distinct next-work obligations**, live v6: distinguish missing statements, allocations, verification plans, changed inputs and unresolved reviews. AC-1 requires explained population/gap; AC-2 prevents interpreting structural gaps as failed execution or absent implementation.
- **Verify REQ-011 queue explanations**, case v14: **Verified for this declared scope**; requirement declared v5, governing basis current; complete source coverage, zero unassigned criteria, current selection, zero unassessed activities. Both AC-1 and AC-2 passed/current. Retained conclusion native revision 141. This is explicitly separate from representative-user validation and release approval.
- Four recorded activities remain visible: original genuine failure (AC-1 failed, AC-2 not_run), original corrected passing activity, subsequent passing comparison-refactor activity, and actual exact configuration-change candidate passing activity. First three are superseded with unknown support; last is selected with no unassessed support change. Historical pass/fail is therefore distinct from current applicability.
- Configuration **REQ-011 original verified source states — retrospective explicit scope**: 15 members, requirement pinned v1, plan v3, model v1, one relationship and 12 observations. Configuration **REQ-011 current configuration-change candidate — exact after scope**: 17 members, requirement v5, plan v5, model v1, one relationship and 14 observations, adding procedure and manifest records. Both declare partial scope. The original is explicitly retrospective using genuine original receipt pins/observations, not an invented contemporaneous capture. Unselected case-control/other dependencies remain unknown. Captured-subject v5 in the header is distinct from the original member's pinned v1, which requires attention to provenance.
- **Assess real REQ-011 support after configuration-change implementation**, v23: **Scope accounted, 18/18**, recorded state completed, discovery current, zero open actions. Purpose preserves unchanged criteria, actual changed comparison sources, original failed/not-run and passing results, and requires actual exact-after reverification.

## Candidate clarity and uncertainty

The revised list materially fixes the fixture ambiguity: rows now start **Record** or **Evaluation**, include a short identity and evaluation purpose/outcome before the artifact title. Opening, execution attestation, result selection, reopening, basis revision and controlled conclusion are distinguishable without opening every row. Long purpose text is truncated, but identity and purpose remain useful.

An exact-after execution candidate said **No selected after native state: outside or unresolved in this pair** for the verification case, alongside **no known changed inputs** and the warning that full receipt applicability can remain unknown outside scope. This is clearer than `vunknown`: it communicates missing pair selection, not a lost live record or a failed result. It still combines two possible causes (outside vs unresolved), so users cannot tell which applies from that sentence alone. The partial-scope warning prevents a no-impact inference.

## Material remaining orientation obstruction

**Medium:** implementation/delivery and human-validation states were not exposed in the standard artifact view. **WORK-027 — Build configuration-aware engineering change management** showed only title, relation to REQ-035 and history. I opened its edit surface solely to inspect available fields, changed nothing, and cancelled: it also offered only title. Consequently, UI evidence supports the completed scoped REQ-011 verification/assessment, but did not let me establish WORK-027's delivery status, implementation completion, human-validation status, or exact outstanding work. This is a concrete missing status/context problem rather than evidence for a new dashboard.

REQ-035 live v11 exposes all twelve acceptance criteria and linked foundation verification reports. Its plan **VER-035** says to execute every unchanged criterion on exact candidates with real/two-domain task evidence and preservation. Criteria explicitly require unfamiliar-agent completion with material findings addressed, separate human validation, real Tracer and materially different-domain proof, boundaries/drift/supersession, migration/backup/recovery, regressions, documentation/register evidence and final full-goal audit. Linked reports establish that individual work is recorded; their presence alone cannot establish all criteria passed or that the full capability is complete. I cannot responsibly classify those listed obligations as remaining versus already fulfilled from the fields inspected.

## Responsive check and limitations

At 390 × 844, the VER-035 artifact view had body width/scroll width 390/390. Title, method, relation and timeline were contained and readable (screenshot `real-project-mobile.png`). Mobile assessment-row/context containment was not completed before the stop instruction.

Not completed: deeper inspection of WORK-026, individual REQ-035 report outcomes or a full criterion-by-criterion remaining-work audit. No new engineering execution or human validation was performed. An initial search interaction mistakenly targeted button role although results expose option role; inspecting visible DOM semantics resolved it without product changes.

Preview status/open succeeded but two snapshots timed out. The previously authorized persistent Node Playwright UI-only fallback was used. These tool failures are separate from product findings. Browser navigation route: landing → Next work → Search REQ-011 → artifact → Project tools/Verification → existing case → Configurations/original and current captures → Change assessments/existing completed assessment → execution candidate → Search REQ-035 → WORK-027 → VER-035. No save/lifecycle operation was invoked.

findings.landing: Real connected project landing resolves the tiny-fixture landing concern.
findings.candidateClarity: Revised kind/identity/evaluation-purpose rows materially resolve prior ambiguity.
findings.statusVisibility: Standard default reader showed only title/statement/acceptance, hiding other schema-declared project properties.
findings.limitations: The read-only follow-up was stopped before deeper remaining-work and mobile assessment inspection. It is not an independent repeat of the earlier full 8/8 task or representative-human validation.

correction.behavior: Default artifact reader now displays remaining selected record fields as escaped read-only labeled properties. Project-specific delivery/verification/validation and remaining-work strings are visible without inferring a controlled result. Text edits preserve properties.

verification.scope: Production entry point at 390px; independent delivery/verification/validation values, false/zero/null/JSON/prototype-like own key, no observer or database write while reading, no horizontal body overflow, preservation through title save/reload.

qualification: Agent comprehension plus software regression evidence only. Full original REQ-035 controlled acceptance remains unfinished; representative-human, physical/regulatory, new-backend and arbitrary-scale claims are excluded.
